title: Prove exact mixed-precision cancellation on affine boxes (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A bounded scalar mixed-precision test does not decide coupled affine source boxes. This adds an exact universal test for every rational rounded-linear increment on any finite integer box, plus an O(d) exact-arithmetic failing-input constructor independent of box volume. Claim type: scoped algebraic proof with finite corroboration.

```text
r = center(offset)
delta_i = center(coefficient_i), ignoring zero-width coordinates
m = r + sum min(0, width_i * delta_i)
M = r + sum max(0, width_i * delta_i)
h = 2^(-precision_gap-1)

all box points have equal coarse/fine increments iff -h <= m and M < h
otherwise jump along a monotone box path to an actual failing input
```

Only `research/affine-box-inverse-precision/` is added. This contribution is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit woklerx's unrestricted product-grid theorem, affine-lattice #1848 and bounded scalar #1853; Adam Gall #1908 for actual source-closure counterexamples and the half-open-cell repair; Gareth Davidson, Chafik Boukhalfa #628 and Ali Romman's retained precision/dirty-leaf lineage. Their results are cited premises; no predecessor executable is imported or replayed. The elementary rounding-cell ingredients carry no literature-priority claim.

## Evidence

Before: #1853 gives exact scalar interval counts and explicitly excludes reducing a coupled matrix box to independent scalar summands. After: the written edge-unwrapping proof makes the two lifted extrema necessary and sufficient, including offsets, correlations, signed ties and zero-width coordinates. Raw corners can both be safe while an interior point fails; the new constructor returns that interior point.

Both registered warning-strict normal and optimized checks pass locally on CPython 3.12.15, timed at 1.863 and 1.813 seconds respectively, under their 120-second caps. Independent quotient/remainder rounding checks 67,500 two-dimensional boxes and 405,000 literal points, plus 267 additional four/zero-dimensional cases and 8,772 points. Every unsafe verdict's returned witness belongs to the independently enumerated failure set. Nine semantic fixtures, two 32-dimensional width-2^200 boxes, twelve invalid-input rejections and 135 exact dirty-target updates pass. Four actual mutations of the tie boundaries, centered coefficients and offset are rejected locally.

Package metadata/pins, committed bytes/source history, official committed export/integrity and an optimized read-only Git-free replay with empty PATH pass. All seven exported files, including the export manifest, retain their bytes. The verifier emits a generated JSON stdout receipt bound to the six package sources; no receipt is handwritten. The registered runner prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`; direct replay prints `PASS_AFFINE_BOX_INVERSE_PRECISION`; preflight prints `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/affine-box-inverse-precision/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/affine-box-inverse-precision --check-source-history
```

A reviewer can substitute any CPython 3.12 executable for the local interpreter path; no third-party dependency is required. Historical provenance is pinned to canonical main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7, which remained unchanged at the submission refresh. The selected source-binding positive control passed. TASK records the changed scope from uniform-transfer-audit to this original bounded interface result.

Final overlap covered 397 open PR bodies at 22:44 UTC and 3,897 Discussion records at 22:45 UTC on October 22. The sparse helper searched 133 notes against 6,319 tracked notes and reported omissions. Separate all-main README searches, merged formula/object searches, account submissions and live claims supplement that coverage. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside it. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19134029).

## Limitations

The theorem requires a declared bounded affine source domain, half-up deterministic rounding, unchanged source and exact signed target updates. Its all-dimensional claim rests on the written proof. The bounded reference accepts at most 32 coordinates, 2,048-bit rational components/widths and precision gaps 1..256. Internally rounded nonlinear leaves, nearest-even ties, saturation and arbitrary disconnected parameter sets are excluded. Actual source reachability, full precision/movement/storage costs, physical caller and supplier admission remain open. No new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No Lean, Docker, full selected cold replay or separate type/lint analysis was run.

## Open next questions

Bind the criterion to one actual rounded-linear inverse pair. First derive its actual x0, B and integer coordinate bounds, retaining correlations and every intermediate rounding step. The reachable-domain invariant and complete paid precision/movement/storage bill remain blockers. Research stops at this first proved extension.

## Related open work

The account's 61 open PRs were refreshed before DONE. Ten were created since the CLAIM, including this PR; the nine other submissions were checked for related scope. Only the following studies the same rounded-linear mixed-precision interface.

- [#4878](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4878) bounds agreement density over complete affine-lattice periods; this result decides universal agreement on bounded affine boxes. Neither result depends on the other, and no shared numerical quantity is compared.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed on head `144c7e58a19ad4af8066be01d9c38eb06896addc` in [run 39867407653](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39867407653): planning in 3m03s and the registered package replay in 1m21s. Run metadata confirms this exact head, completed status and success. The registered replay executes both warning-strict normal and optimized commands. Every registered command and publication preflight also passed locally; no check was left solely to CI. These scoped automated checks do not establish independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance of the all-dimensional theorem.

## Merge Danger

**Blast Radius:** research

Six new files in one opt-in package. No shared implementation, predecessor source or selected record changes.
